preconditions: Lamp at room temperature and switched off for at least [soak time in min]
setup: Mount the lamp in an integrating sphere
Supply the lamp at [supply voltage in V]
steps: Start recording luminous flux at [sample rate in Hz] or faster
Switch the lamp on and note the switch-on time
Record the time at which luminous flux first reaches 400 lm
response.expected_result: Luminous flux reaches at least 400 lm within 2.0 s of switch-on.
response.pass_criterion: Luminous flux ≥ 400 lm, reached ≤ 2.0 s after switch-on

setup: Mount the lamp in an integrating sphere

response.inspect: Colour of the outer housing, under daylight, against [colour reference]
The housing, for a label stating the voltage
response.pass_condition: A voltage label is present on the housing.

response.description: An operator switches the lamp on and off using one hand only.
procedure: Hold the lamp in one hand, or mount it as installed
Operate the switch with the same hand, without using the other hand
response.acceptance_criterion: The switch is operated with one hand with a force of no more than [maximum force in N].

response.inspect: The lamp's mounting interface, fitted to a 35 mm rail or to a wall bracket
response.pass_condition: The lamp mounts on a 35 mm rail, or on a wall bracket.

response.description: Structural calculation of the bracket under a static load.
evidence: Stress calculation or FEA report showing peak stress below yield at 50 N
response.acceptance_criterion: Peak stress at a 50 N static load is below the yield strength of [bracket material].
